source: Latest attached LifeSimulator specification and corrected token folder tree

dynamicBloodline.folder_name_source: The first true soul-bonded animal or creature name
dynamicBloodline.rule: The first true soul-bonded animal or creature permanently establishes an open-ended soul-animal bloodline.

races.name: Azae’Ioaiz
races.canonicalProfile: Large, exceptionally long-lived blue arthropodal beings with a centipede-like head, mandibles, antennae, and dozens to hundreds of jointed legs. Their medium-mass bodies support omnivorous diets and broad individual variation.

races.name: Azhurai Striders
races.canonicalProfile: Very tall blue-to-lavender bipeds with elongated heads, flexible antennae, swept ears, long limbs, claws, and a carnivorous bite. They favor low-gravity glacial moons and tall cavern arcologies, reading air pressure and nearby motion through their antennae.

races.name: Bratuith
races.canonicalProfile: Amphibious winged humanoids with smooth moist skin, powerful aquatic sensory adaptation, two arms, two legs, and leathery wings. Their eyes may be red, yellow, dark, or reflective, and their builds range from lean to athletic.

races.name: Cyai’Syne
races.canonicalProfile: Psychically gifted beings with enlarged or laterally extended cranial structures, resonant voices, and the ability to project convincing shared illusions. Their variable profiles may include side-set eyes, paired lower-neck mouths, antlered or rabbit-like facial elements, and herbivorous desert diets.

races.name: Daiaeyzyix
races.canonicalProfile: Very small, lightweight beings with wrinkled broad foreheads, short muzzles, and multiple dark red or luminous eyes. Their compact bodies commonly consume small animals, insects, and other setting-valid foods.

races.name: Elarin Veilborn
races.canonicalProfile: Elegant green-gold humanoids with swept ears, shallow brow ridges, luminous geometric markings, mirrored pupils, and translucent hair tips. They excel at reading facial detail and polarized light and communicate through speech, marking luminosity, controlled shimmer, and formal veil styling.

races.name: Feiwhieiýea
races.canonicalProfile: Very tall, physically powerful aliens with broad reptilian or rhinoceros-like heads, layered facial ridges, bony forehead projections, and strong jaws. Gray or mottled pebbled hide may be joined by fur or feather accents and large, steady eyes.

races.name: Gravari Runeborn
races.canonicalProfile: Gray-ochre mineral humanoids with ribbed necks, cranial plates, luminous rune seams, and compact breathing collars. Adapted to thin-atmosphere mesas and mineral worlds, they sense vibration through their feet and emphasize speech with rune-light and precise hand geometry.

races.name: Hukhezhian
races.canonicalProfile: Robust, high-pressure-adapted humanoids with thick leathery skin, coarse hair, intense red, yellow, or black eyes, and sophisticated life-support equipment. Their physiology is suited to environments that would be hazardous to many ordinary humanoids.

races.name: Ioaeaeudi
races.canonicalProfile: Humanoids whose face is set into the chest or upper torso rather than a separate head. They possess two arms and two legs, three-fingered dexterous hands, three-toed clawed feet, and compact mouth and nasal structures.

races.name: Khiatuukho
races.canonicalProfile: Three-eyed, poison-resistant winged beings with a heavy cranial plate extending down the face, a prominent brow and nasal lobe, and paired facial barbels. Avian or beaked traits may accompany two arms, two legs, and a functional wing pair.

races.name: Korvathi Crownkin
races.canonicalProfile: Robust umber-to-slate humanoids with ridged brows, two horns, three short hollow crown arches, small tusks, and paired heartbeat lights. Their crown structures map echoes and vibration, supporting close-range spatial awareness and resonant communication.

races.name: Me’Ivaimy
races.canonicalProfile: Blue-green to gray aquatic-looking quadrupeds with moist or scaled skin, four lionlike legs, and predatory or reflective eyes. They can enter a catatonic state during interstellar travel and require substantial protein after awakening.

races.name: Myralume Navigators
races.canonicalProfile: Amphibious humanoids with seafoam-copper skin, pearlescent eyes, webbed fingers, small gill fans, and a living shoulder mantle. They detect pressure shifts in air or water and communicate through speech, throat resonance, mantle patterns, and diving hand signs.

races.name: Nerathi Tidebound
races.canonicalProfile: Sea-green amphibious humanoids with glossy dark eyes, finned sensory braids, gill seams, and pearl-lined resonance throats. They possess strong chemical sensing in water and use speech, song, harmonics, and coordinated crown motion.

races.name: Nieeiial
races.canonicalProfile: Rocklike beings with gray, brown, and red mineral surfaces, luminous or molten-looking patches, and corrosive tunneling secretions. Their forms may move by flowing or burrowing through stone or combine insectoid sensory structures with multi-jointed humanoid limbs.

races.name: Othayé
races.canonicalProfile: A highly variable people whose common compact forms have pale lilac, gray, bluish, green, or yellow-green skin, three-fingered hands, and three-toed clawed feet. Some rare manifestations are immense marine or vortex-like bodies rather than ordinary humanoids.

races.name: Phuphoabid
races.canonicalProfile: Tall-headed humanoids with narrow, deeply grooved faces, high craniums, and large black eyes adapted to dim subterranean cities. They retain practical humanoid proportions, dexterous hands, and a strong sensory or cultural affinity with earth and minerals.

races.name: Qokâevum
races.canonicalProfile: Small blue beings with wrinkled broad faces, animal-like traits, large dexterous hands, and broad feet. Their profiles can include corrosive digestive secretions and unusually strong botanical senses or aptitudes.

races.name: Rkatruizhu
races.canonicalProfile: Compact humanoids with smooth or finely scaled skin, narrow wedge-shaped heads, small muzzles, dexterous hands, clawed feet, and balancing tails. Their source profile supports omnivorous diets and strong traditions of hospitality and pleasure-centered cuisine.

races.name: Shaeshunuu
races.canonicalProfile: Tall, wrinkled, sparse-haired humanoids with deep-set eyes, broad hands, sturdy feet, fangs, and a predatory proboscis-like tongue. Their specialized diet centers on blood and nutrient-rich organs and requires explicit setting and consent boundaries.

races.name: Sonori Oracles
races.canonicalProfile: Pale blue-gray humanoids with fine nose ridges, backward-swept craniums, paired temple lights, four-fingered hands, and iridescent throat membranes. Two complementary attention streams support navigation and counterpoint, expressed through layered song and ritual breath.

races.name: Thay'lmériûn
races.canonicalProfile: Extremely advanced humanoid aliens who feed on life essence and years, produce the euphoric and highly addictive substance Ichor, and gain greater telepathic and telekinetic power when well nourished. They can mimic identities, engineer living systems, and create artificial life while varying widely in ethics, culture, and appearance.

races.name: Tinkari Hearthlings
races.canonicalProfile: Small furry adults with huge scalloped ears, amber night-eyes, fine hands, and subtly sharp teeth. They thrive in compact artificial habitats, localize machinery faults through wide-band hearing, and communicate through quick speech, ear posture, tool taps, and repair marks.

races.name: Trellik Verdants
races.canonicalProfile: Tall plant-symbiotic humanoids with spot trails, bark patches, branched leaf-veined sensory tendrils, and luminous sternum symbionts. Their tendrils sample light, humidity, volatile chemistry, and plant stress while also supporting scent and gesture-based communication.

races.name: Usiêshyy
races.canonicalProfile: Adaptive cybernetic or assimilative beings whose bodies may combine pallid implanted humanoid features, dense fur, and much larger winged morphs. Their anatomy and scale vary substantially according to incorporated biology and specialized technology.

races.name: Vaidikion
races.canonicalProfile: Heavy, muscular humanoids with robust skulls, complex ridged foreheads, two arms, two legs, and dark steady eyes. Ridge patterns vary by individual and can remain recognizable across age, equipment, and cultural presentation.

races.name: Vesperyx Skymanes
races.canonicalProfile: Feline humanoids with patterned fur, dramatic manes, chitin shoulder plates, compact beetle wings, temple eye-freckles, fangs, and barbed tails. They combine low-light vision with airflow sensing and communicate through speech, ears, tails, wings, and mane ornamentation.

races.name: Xokokror
races.canonicalProfile: Reptilian humanoids with smooth-to-pebbled skin, adhesive hand pads, and metabolism capable of supporting a joined symbiont. Their profiles may also include luminous feather-like structures and broad individual variation in mass and build.

races.name: Yuyeiaeeaiel
races.canonicalProfile: Tall armored serpentine beings with elongated heads, narrow lower faces, high crowns, and humanoid arms and hands. Their scaled bodies combine an upright social silhouette with a powerful species-typical serpent form.

races.name: Zokrauzaü
races.canonicalProfile: Exceptionally agile shapeshifters with variable skin and hair, narrow drooping snouts, and two major body states: a full humanoid body and a limbless flying form. Individual presentation and coloration vary widely.
